name: dp-agent-marketplace
description: Self-hosted marketplace for the dp-agent plugin — ticket-to-draft-MR workflow skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: dp-agent
plugins.description: Standardises the path from a Jira ticket to a draft merge request: ticket quality check, implementation plan, commit/PR drafting, git-state explanation, PR scope check, a full pre-merge review gate for correctness, security, gaps and quality, and a resumable fix loop that works through its findings.
